# SickMotos · Rent a Moto Zadar

> Motorbike and scooter rental in Zadar, Croatia. Scooters and motorbikes
> from 50cc to 390cc. Helmets and basic insurance always included. Ideal
> for exploring Zadar, the Dalmatian coast and the nearby islands.

## Key facts

- Location: Velebitska Ulica 2, 23000 Zadar, Croatia
- Hours: every day, 09:00–19:00 (Europe/Zagreb)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +49 176 34658003
- Website: https://rentamotozadar.com
- Languages spoken: German, English, Croatian, Italian, Polish, French, Spanish
- Rating: 4.9 / 5 on Google
- Booking: online, 20% reservation fee secures the dates

## Fleet

- Piaggio Liberty 50 — 50cc scooter, AM/B licence, ideal for the city
- Piaggio Liberty 50 Topcase — 50cc scooter with extra storage
- Piaggio Liberty 125 — 125cc scooter, great range for longer coastal trips
- Beta RR 125 — 125cc enduro/supermoto
- KTM Duke 125 — 125cc naked bike
- KTM Duke 390 — 390cc, A2 licence, the most powerful in the fleet

## What's included

- Helmets (always included)
- Basic insurance (theft + engine damage)
- Unlimited kilometres
- 250€ deposit

## Common questions

- Helmets are included with every rental.
- Deposit (250€) is payable on pickup; the 20% reservation fee is paid online to secure the dates.
- Licence required depends on the bike: AM/B for 50cc, A1 for 125cc, A2 for the 390cc.
- Multiple bikes for a group can be arranged — check availability on the site or ask.

## Booking

Book directly at https://rentamotozadar.com — pick a bike, choose dates and
times, pay the 20% reservation fee. Availability is live on each bike page.
